message.content: Add a trim(text, width) helper to textkit that cuts text to width characters.

content.text: Added textkit/trim.py on branch feat/trim and committed it. trim(text, width) returns the first width characters; a negative width prints a warning and returns the text unchanged.

message.content: What does the README say textkit is for?

content.text: There is no README yet. The package holds small text helpers: trim is the only one so far.

message.content: Should we pin a Python version for this package?

content.text: Not yet: nothing in textkit needs a feature newer than the oldest supported Python. Pin one when a dependency or syntax requires it.
